subject: Want in?
body: The bot's up nicely since launch. I'll sell you a small stake for 50 DOLR — it tracks the bot's P&L, so it rises when the thing trades well and bleeds when it doesn't. You can sell anytime.

outcomes.when: the player agrees to buy the stake / buy in
outcomes.reply: Done. You're in. Try not to watch it every five minutes.
No worries. Offer stands if you change your mind.

hints: 50 DOLR for a stake that rises or falls with how well your bot trades.
